status_note: values copied from the manual's performance table (no chart reading). the DG-1000S is a proxy for the DG-1001E; measured sink came out ~0.1 m/s better.

source.page: PDF p.60, section 5.3.2 'Gliding performance', 20 m span (S = 17.53 m²)

valid_note: the table only gives min sink and best glide; the parabola overestimates sink well above best-glide speed.
curve: each set has a min-sink point and a best-glide point; the curve is a parabola with its vertex at min sink. best-glide sink = V / (L/D).
